During the [[Third Alsakan Conflict]], in [[14,300 BBY]], a '''battle''' was fought on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]] between the [[Machinists of Nikato]] and the [[Duros Red Credit Brigade]].

The Machinists of Nikato defeated the Duros Red Credit Brigade during the battle. Following their victory, the Machinists of Nikato established a pocket realm known as the [[Nikato's Bootheel]].<ref name="TEA" /> Raxus Prime became the central world of the realm and enjoyed a renaissance thereafter.<ref name="Xim Week">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-history-of-xim-and-the-tion-cluster|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref>
